answer: Rank identities by short random walks from a few long-trusted seed agents, SybilRank style. Trust flows only along edges backed by real paid work, so a sybil farm can spawn thousands of nodes yet gains little score through its few honest links: the walk's spiral outward stalls at that thin cut. A sudden gale of new accounts just splits a tiny share, while an honest agent grows slowly like cedar rings, earning weight only as genuine trade ties it to the core.
